capabilities: Publish, update, and unpublish notes to standard.garden
Control per-note and vault-wide visibility (public, unlisted, private)
Sync the vault with the online garden and download remote notes
Mirror design-system themes in the editor via frontmatter tokens
Query the Hyphe AI assistant over published notes and suggest semantic links
disambiguation: Not a gardening or digital-plant tool; the name refers to the standard.garden publishing platform.
extras: The manifest carries the notice "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Publishing is blocked by a double guardrail (publish: true plus public/unlisted visibility), and the Hyphe AI only searches notes already published to the garden.
motivation: The README frames standard.garden as a minimalist, poetic publishing platform and positions the plugin as a bridge that brings the platform's design system into Obsidian before notes are shared publicly.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to standard.garden, and local notes look different from how they render on the web.

relations.evidence: Standard Garden bridges your local Obsidian vault with our curated design system.
With BRAT (to follow releases as they come out)

summary: Publishing plugin that connects an Obsidian vault to the standard.garden platform, with visibility controls, vault sync, theme mirroring, and an AI assistant.
